exposure: Women with epilepsy using one AED (monotherapy)
Number of AEDs used (monotherapy vs. polytherapy)
Women with epilepsy using more than one AED (polytherapy)
cohort: 153 pregnant women with epilepsy exposed to AEDs
finding: Women with epilepsy using AEDs during pregnancy experienced higher rates of gestational hypertension and preterm delivery compared to the general population, with polytherapy associated with increased risks.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was higher in the polytherapy group (27.5%).
